text: Security plugin can scan authorized code and confirm plausible vulnerability findings
quote: Install the Codex Security plugin to scan authorized code and confirm plausible vulnerability findings.

text: Gmail plugin lets Codex work with Gmail
quote: Install the Gmail plugin to work with Gmail.

text: Google Drive plugin works across Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides
quote: Install the Google Drive plugin to work across Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides.

text: Slack plugin can summarize channels or draft replies
quote: Install the Slack plugin to summarize channels or draft replies.

text: A plugin can read/search iMessage, SMS, RCS chats and send messages on the user's behalf
quote: it can read and search iMessage, SMS, and RCS chats on your Mac and send messages on your behalf through the Messages app

text: '/plugins' command opens an in-CLI plugin browser to explore available plugins
quote: In Codex CLI, enter `/plugins` to open the plugin browser.

text: A skill-creation assistant interactively asks what the skill does, when it triggers, and whether it needs scripts
quote: The creator asks what the skill does, when it should trigger, and whether it should stay instruction-only or include scripts.

text: '$skill-installer' lets you add curated skills beyond the built-ins for your local Codex setup
quote: To add curated skills beyond the built-ins for your own local Codex setup, use `$skill-installer`.

text: Teams can check in skills scoped to a specific working folder like a microservice or module
quote: teams can check in skills relevant to a working folder. For example, skills only relevant to a microservice or a module.

text: Built-in '@plugin-creator' skill scaffolds the plugin.json manifest and can generate a local marketplace entry for testing
quote: For the fastest setup, use the built-in `@plugin-creator` skill. It scaffolds the required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` manifest and can also generate a local marketplace entry for testing.

text: 'codex plugin marketplace add' command adds and tracks a marketplace source instead of manual config editing
quote: Use `codex plugin marketplace add` to add and track a marketplace source instead of editing `config.toml` by hand.

text: Figma plugin provides use_figma, Code to Canvas, Code Connect, and design system rules
quote: plugins/figma for `use_figma`, Code to Canvas, Code Connect, and design system rules

text: iOS app-building plugin supports SwiftUI implementation, refactors, performance, and debugging
quote: plugins/build-ios-apps for SwiftUI implementation, refactors, performance, and debugging

text: Web app-building plugin supports deployment, UI, payments, and database workflows
quote: plugins/build-web-apps for deployment, UI, payments, and database workflows

text: Notion plugin supports planning, research, meetings, and knowledge capture
quote: plugins/notion for planning, research, meetings, and knowledge capture

text: 'Sign in with ChatGPT' is rolling out in beta for supported plugins and partner sites like Airtable, GitLab, HubSpot, Notion, Supabase, and Vercel
quote: Sign in with ChatGPT is rolling out in beta for supported plugins and partner sites, including Airtable, GitLab, HubSpot, Notion, Supabase, and Vercel.

text: A skill is defined as a directory with a SKILL.md file (with required name and description) plus optional scripts/references
quote: A skill is a directory with a `SKILL.md` file plus optional scripts and references. The `SKILL.md` file must include `name` and `description`.

text: Plugin-creator skill wires up an MCP server as part of creating a new plugin
quote: The plugin-creator skill will create the plugin folder, create the required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, and add MCP server wiring for the plugin.

text: Expo plugin supports Expo/React Native apps, SDK upgrades, EAS workflows, and Codex Run actions
quote: `plugins/expo` for Expo and React Native apps, SDK upgrades, EAS workflows, and Codex Run actions

text: A recorder can capture a workflow demonstration and draft a reusable skill from it
quote: The recorder captures the workflow, inspects the steps, and drafts a reusable skill from the demonstration.

text: Codex scans .agents/skills in every directory from cwd up to the repo root, enabling project-scoped skill discovery
quote: Codex scans `.agents/skills` in every directory from your current working directory up to the repository root.

text: Signing in with ChatGPT only shares name, email, and profile picture, and does not grant plugin data access or auto-approve actions
quote: Signing in shares only your name, email address, and profile picture, when available, with the partner. It doesn't grant the plugin access to your data or approve actions automatically.

text: '/skills' command or typing '$' lets you mention/invoke a skill directly in Codex CLI or IDE extension
quote: In Codex CLI or the IDE extension, run `/skills` or type `$` to mention a skill.

text: skill-installer can target and install a single named skill (e.g. linear) rather than a whole bundle
quote: $skill-installer linear
